At temperature 0.25 on out-of-distribution CNN/DailyMail articles, **DPO** gets a GPT-4 win rate of **0.31** against the ground-truth summaries, and **PPO** gets **0.23** (Table 1, p. 9).

These policies were trained on Reddit TL;DR and evaluated with the same GPT-4 (C) prompt, with "forum post" replaced by "news article" (p. 9).
